name: @pipeworx/mcp-france-bdpm-medicines

tools.name: fr_medicine
tools.description: One French medicine by its CIS code or exact official name, from the BDPM (France's official public medicines database, published by ANSM/CNAM). Returns the specialty's status and marketing authorization, every CIP13 pack presentation with its reimbursement rate and price, active-substance composition, HAS SMR/ASMR opinions (service medical rendu / amelioration du service medical rendu), generic-group membership and any "usage professionnel" restriction. Use for "what is the reimbursement rate for Doliprane 1000mg", "what is in CIS 60234100", or looking up a French drug by its exact brand/INN name. For partial or fuzzy name matches use fr_medicine_search first.

cis.description: CIS code (Code Identifiant de Specialite), e.g. "60234100".

name.description: Exact official denomination, e.g. "DOLIPRANE 1000 mg, comprimé". Case/accent-insensitive. Use fr_medicine_search for partial names.

tools.name: fr_medicine_search
tools.description: Search French medicines in the BDPM by the start of their name and/or by an active substance, returning matching specialties (CIS code, denomination, holder, pharmaceutical form, marketing status). Use for "medicines containing paracetamol", "search Doliprane", or finding a CIS code to pass to fr_medicine. Prefix match only ("DOLIPRANE" finds "DOLIPRANE 1000 mg..." but not "CODOLIPRANE"); pass both name and substance to intersect.

name.description: Start of the medicine's official denomination, e.g. "DOLIPRANE".

substance.description: Start of an active substance name, e.g. "PARACETAMOL".

tools.name: fr_generic_group
tools.description: One BDPM generic group by its group id: the reference (princeps) specialty and every generic/substitutable member, each with its CIS code, denomination and generic type. Use after fr_medicine returns a generic_group.group_id, to see every interchangeable specialty in that group.

group_id.description: Generic group id, from fr_medicine's generic_group.group_id.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-france-bdpm-medicines forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the france-bdpm-medicines pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
